purpose: T063 claim-A rebuttal hygiene: the rogue-dimension control. z-score each of the 32 head-dim coordinates per (layer,head) over the pooled own+donor V-sets (recipient none-arm anchor-band set + sibling/middle/foreign spliced sets — one common frame), then recompute (a) the family cosines mean|cos(old,donor)| (before: the published 0.4032/0.1410/0.1383 step) and (b) the e111-style subspace occupancy E_donor(k) in the standardized own-PCA (headline k=8) + same-norm gaussian nulls. SURVIVES (sibling >= 2x foreign in mean|cos| OR E(8) >= 2x) => rogue-dimension confound EXCLUDED, T060/T061 hardened; COLLAPSES (neither 2x and sib ~= foreign) => ANISOTROPY-DRIVEN, major reframe.
